title: dfilter: Return an error object instead of string
description:
Return an struct containing error information. This simplifies
the interface to more easily provide richer diagnostics in the future.

Add an error code besides a human-readable error string to allow
checking programmatically for errors in a robust manner. Currently
there is only a generic error code, it is expected to increase
in the future.

Move error location information to the struct. Change callers and
implementation to use the new interface.

notes.body: This creates a lot of Coverity warnings about cases when `dfilter_compile_real` doesn't set `errpp` and it's later dereferenced. I believe, however, when that happens that `ws_critical` is called, which always aborts the program, as the fatal log level has to be critical or higher.
Although perhaps `ws_critical` can be set to be the fatal log level, but is not always fatal, in which case `errpp` should be set to something if we're returning false.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -22,7 +22,7 @@
 #include <wsutil/ws_assert.h>
 
 #define FAIL(dfw, node, ...) \
-	dfilter_fail_throw(dfw, stnode_location(node), __VA_ARGS__)
+	dfilter_fail_throw(dfw, DF_ERROR_GENERIC, stnode_location(node), __VA_ARGS__)
 
 /* Convert an FT_STRING using a callback function */
 static gboolean
